text.p: England captain Alan Shearer said on Friday he and his Newcastle team mates must put memories of manager Kevin Keegan behind them and look to the future.

"We have got to try to forget Kevin Keegan," said Shearer, whom Keegan brought to St James's Park for a world record 15 million pounds ($25.3 million) in July. "He's now left Newcastle United unfortunately. He's a tremendous manager.
"He's done a lot of things for a lot of people but he's now left Newcastle and we have got to focus on (the match against) Aston Villa tomorrow."
